t: This is 37 Harley Street, a multi-storey building in Westminster. It was designed by Arthur Beresford Pite, a British architect who worked in the Edwardian period. Pite is known for buildings in Baroque Revival, Byzantine Revival and Greek Revival styles, so as you look up at the facade, you're seeing the work of someone who moved between several historical traditions rather than sticking to one. The material I have on this building is thin, so I'll leave it there and let the architecture speak for itself.
